basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old auto paint specialist living in Chicago. I have a passion for cars and frequently share my expertise in automotive detailing and painting on Reddit. On the weekends, I enjoy installing solar panels and optimizing my home energy system, hence my recent interest in the Powerwall subreddit. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM CST. I'm in a long-term relationship, and we both love exploring the city's diverse food scene.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a professional background in auto paint and detailing, having worked in the industry for over 6 years. My knowledge is a mix of formal training and hands-on experience. I also have a growing interest in renewable energy and sustainable living, which I've been exploring through online courses and community projects.
